headword: {産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい}

definitions.explanation: The major transformation of manufacturing and industry that began in Britain in the late 18th century. Also used more broadly to describe any large-scale industrial transformation.

examples.japanese: {産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦イギリス→イギリス：28283_igirisu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain.

examples.japanese: AI⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{第四次|だいよじ}{産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: AI is called the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

examples.japanese: {産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The Industrial Revolution drastically changed people's lives.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard historical term taught in Japanese schools. Also used metaphorically: {第三次|だいさんじ}{産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい} (Third Industrial Revolution), {第四次|だいよじ}{産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい} (Fourth Industrial Revolution) referring to digital and AI transformations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {第一次|だいいちじ}{産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい} (First Industrial Revolution)
- {産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (era of the Industrial Revolution)
- {産業|さんぎょう}{革命|かくめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (an industrial revolution occurs)
